description: Purpose: Lists all 14 public iResolve private pre-work and calm written alignment scenario templates across English and French. Use when: Selecting a workplace, co-founder, board, commercial, condo, or family scenario slug before creating a room link. Do not use when: Constructing a launch URL directly (use create_alignment_room_link) or retrieving pricing and peer-reviewed methodology (use get_prework_methodology). Returns & Zero-PII Guarantee: Stateless, read-only, idempotent catalog lookup with zero authentication and zero database writes; confidential party narratives never enter MCP tool inputs or outputs, keeping MCP Gateway JSON-RPC call logs 100% zero-PII.

locale.description: Optional ISO language filter ('en' for 7 English entries or 'fr' for 7 French entries). Omit to return all 14 bilingual scenario entries.
